translations.web: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
translations.bsb: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
translations.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
translations.asv: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
